annotations.text: Authored from WK-2063 and related WK-1713, WK-1795, and WK-1824. Existing boundedWkLifecycleRegion and resolveFixedWkForkCommit are the single mechanism family to generalize.

boundedWkLifecycleRegion is the single producer of authenticated fixed-fork observations. A pre-admission recovery invocation emits its own recovery occurrence and it must not be reused by a later fresh integration attempt. Each advanceSliceRefCas attempt emits one fresh occurrence that serves both marker and zero-delta candidate classification for that exact WK tip and fixed fork. The concurrency-loser reauthentication in exactConcurrentZeroDeltaWinner emits a fresh bounded occurrence before reclassification. Each canonical work-record CAS live re-validation emits ref-record-cas-live-observation after re-resolving the floor. No occurrence crosses WK-ref movement, fork movement, record-CAS retry, or a fresh integration boundary.

For a well-formed post-fork region whose every ancestry path terminates at the exact fixed WK fork, traversal and literal object-read cost is O(post-fork commits plus relevant marker or evidence candidates) and reads no commit strictly before the fork. A malformed or escaping ancestry path remains fail-closed and may read the escaping parent chain only as needed to establish that it does not terminate at the authenticated fork; this refusal path does not weaken the fixed fork as the authority floor for successful evidence.

Named fail-closed scenarios include malformed claims, wrong delivery, base, WK-parent or subject, merge paths escaping the fixed floor, cycles, missing objects, traversal-bound exhaustion, fork absence, movement or deletion, and WK-ref or record-CAS races.

DRY review wkdb_a2435c38f8a9ce20: accepted DRY-001 by naming boundedWkLifecycleRegion as the single observation producer; accepted DRY-002 by making resolveSliceMarkerEvidence the sole bounded marker classifier and retiring boundedSiblingMarkerEvidence; accepted DRY-004 by reusing the authorization literal commit parser/reader and retiring the delivery copy. Rejected DRY-003 as overbroad: literalReachable remains only for compatibility callers outside WK-2063, while advanceSliceRefCas is forbidden from using it.

WK-2063 now has five ordered independently integrable implementation slices after mandatory atomicity decomposition. controlled-proof-intent.integration-prefix-safety is therefore applicable to every non-empty integrated prefix crossed with the named paths and branches, in addition to controlled-proof-intent.forbidden-operation-noninvocation for the complete public request boundary. The forbidden-operation pack remains applicable but is no longer sufficient by itself. The focused Real-Git verification remains responsible for the positive fixed-fork bound and preserved behavior scenarios. No implementation dispatch is authorized until the integration-prefix intent is selected, exactly bound, and assessed or an unresolved package/tooling gap is explicitly dispositioned by the operator.

Design redteam run wkdb_d4479ffaf12a6d2b reported RT-001 through RT-008. Its single blueteam challenge, run wkdb_730fc892edee7d05, retained RT-001, RT-004 and RT-008; narrowed RT-002, RT-003, RT-005 and RT-006; and rejected RT-007. Coordinator disposition accepts the surviving bounded corrections only: one required-test write-scope addition, well-formed-region qualification, escaping-merge qualification, explicit concurrency-loser and record-CAS observation occurrences, structural-only pre-recovery disposition validation, and refreshed admission evidence. No new lifecycle, generic history refactor, proof intent, dependency, framework, policy, or implementation surface is authorized.
